split_tensor_along_last_dim: split a PyTorch tensor along its last dimension into equal partitions for model parallelism
ensure_divisibility: ensure a numerator is evenly divisible by a denominator and assert if not
divide: safely divide a numerator by a denominator after ensuring even divisibility
vocab_range_from_per_partition_vocab_siz: compute the first and last vocabulary index range for a given partition rank and size
vocab_range_from_global_vocab_size: compute the vocabulary index range for a partition from a global vocabulary size and rank
